title: Additive and scalar operations on dual-number tangent vectors.
statement: theorem tangentVectors_operations (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) (p : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (x : X) : let K := X.residueField x let D := Spec (.of (DualNumber K)) let E := Spec (.of (TrivSqZeroExt K (Fin 2 → K))) let b := X.fromSpecResidueField x let c : Spec K ⟶ D := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (TrivSqZeroExt.fstHom K K K).toRingHom) let q : D ⟶ Spec K := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (TrivSqZeroExt.inlHom K K)) let j : Fin 2 → (D ⟶ E) := fun i => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (TrivSqZeroExt.map (LinearMap.proj i : (Fin 2 → K) →ₗ[K] K)).toRingHom) let s : D ⟶ E := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (TrivSqZeroExt.map ((LinearMap.proj 0 : (Fin 2 → K) →ₗ[K] K) + LinearMap.proj 1)).toRingHom) let m : K → (D ⟶ D) := fun t => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (TrivSqZeroExt.map (t • (LinearMap.id : K →ₗ[K] K))).toRingHom) let T := {θ : D ⟶ X // c ≫ θ = b ∧ θ ≫ p = q ≫ b ≫ p} ∃ a : AddCommGroup T, letI := a; ∃ v : Module K T, letI := v; (0 : T).val = q ≫ b ∧ (∀ θ₁ θ₂ : T, ∀ Θ : E ⟶ X, j 0 ≫ Θ = θ₁.val → j 1 ≫ Θ = θ₂.val → (θ₁ + θ₂).val = s ≫ Θ) ∧ (∀ (t : K) (θ : T), (t • θ).val = m t ≫ θ.val)
